content: Timothy on Paul a Silas mat Sinai
Paul on ibib inai au Derbe ato gibui inai au Lystra. Baitutumotin wabin Timothy on nan imama; on ayon on Jew jever ato on mat on baitutumotin, baise taman on Greek orot.
Taitais tutuas baitutumotis nan Lystra a Iconium simama on Timothy sibifain, dura obis wat aurin sibikakafun.
Paul on igogoi Timothy itboai rus sitan, on mes iaskibubuai. On atonio bobo ifour yabin Jew yangan ato efanai nan simama on engon sisagob, Timothy taman on Greek orot.
Osi si’nan mafam gagamisi si’gat on baifafaro ato baiyoyobotis a ekalesia asi sabu kwatus nan Jerusalem sibiyamai on baitutumotis sikakasones, ato si’yawures on baifafaro aurin sitifonabo mes.
On mes ekalesia yangan asi baitutum on sifaiwaris ato ra ra on sabu sigaraba maiau si’nat baitutumotis simamatar.
God on Troas nan Paul aurin Dura Ibo Igat
Paul tuturan mat on sibib sinai Phrygia a Galatia tafanamai nan sigat, yabin Ayu Kakafotin on men ibasites osi Asia tafanamai nan dura sitkurereb.
Osi sinai Mysia tafanam an faratai nan aurin sibiufin, ato osi sifourtobon Bithynia tafanamai sitar mes, baise Iesu an Ayu on men ibasites osi nan sitar.
On mes osi totor sibib sinai Mysia tafanam ato sisur au Troas mafam gagamin.
On fom on God an dura rerebai ibo igat Paul iyoboai it, on Macedonia orot on itawar ato ibifefeyanai, “Omi wonat au Macedonia ato wonibaisi!”
Paul atonio God an dura iyoboai it mom, wei wabotitiwag watan au Macedonia, yabin wei wainonot on God iyawurei Wasagobin on osi sabu auris wankurereb mes.
Philippi Nan Lydia Inat Baitutumotin Imatar
Wei Troas mafam gagamin waikirir ato wa wabo totor warabon wanai au Samothrace, ato ra itom on wanai au Neapolis.
Wei on mafam emon on wabib wanai au Philippi, on mafam gagamin on Macedonia tafanam an mafam gagamin ainauin bag a Rome yangan mat asi mafam gagamin min on. Wei on wera fani nan mafam gagaminai wama.

Sabat an ra on wei mafam gagamin emon wagat wanai sareu rewanai nan, ato wainonot on efan watnuen watgaturai nan Jew yangan asi bayoi efan aurin. wei wamair ato jever nan siruruayo on auris waikakafun.

Jever tani nan imair dura itatam, on wabin min Lydia, on Thyatira mafam gagamin emon ato on an bobo on beber mururis on ibitotobon, On jever on God ikwakwafirai, ato Bada nunuan iruseren Paul an dura ibikakafun on wat itatamai.
Lydia a sabu on an goai simama on sibapataito. Namon on ibebegis iyau, “Omi woninonot yau on dura bagai Bada abitutumai on, basit omi wonnat yau au goai wonama.” Ato on nana idodowi aurin watan mes.
Philippi, Fafatum Goai Nan

Ra tani wei wa’nan efan menan Jew yangan seruruayo sebabayoi on nan, ato agirotin jeverei tefanai ayu komasin imama on mat wainofoten, on ayu komasin on jeverei ibiyamai ato ra gibui bobo mamaba sinmamatar auris on sabu ikakasones. On atonio bobo ra gibui aifan sinmamatar aurin, on sabu ikakasones an agim on gagamin bag iboai ato sabu iyabon on jeverei ibinoanis on agim siboai.
On jeverei on nana wei a Paul mat ibigibubunuei ato auri ibiyoku i’yau, “Atonio osi sabu on God Aiyetunenei Bag an agirotis! Omi mamaba wonyayawas aurin on dura sekurereb!”

Jeverei atonio bobo on nana ra sigaraba ifofour, ato iyamai Paul on yan ikomas ato irutabir ayu aurin iyau, “Iesu Keriso Wabinai awurem, om ato jeverei eikirir egat!” Ra kaita ayu on jeverei ikirir igat.
Jeverei an sabu matuanis on sisagob ari on men agim siboai, on fasinai osi Paul a Silas rus siboes ato sitikwekwerabis sinai babadis auris, baitotobon efanai nan.
Osi siboes sinat Rome babadis nasi sitawar ato siyau, “Atonio osi sabu Jew yangan, ato osi bobo komasis ati mafam gagamin amonai sefofour.
Ot ati baifafaro iyau on men osi asi kik aurin on nin sinibebe; ot on Rome yangan ato atonio kik on men tanboai a tanafour mes.”
Sabu kuayo on sinat fani mat sikaita ato siboes siborarabis dura wawaninai siyawures; ato babadis on Paul a Silas rus asi beber on sisafefen ato wou yangan siyawures urouwawanai siyaswabires.
Osi aumiet bag siborarabis sikomasis weie, fafatum goai sireberues, ato orot fafatum goa an kaifarotin on dura wawaninai siyawur goa metewan on itkuabinen tiwag.
Atonio dura sibitai on nanaba, fafatum goa kaifarotin iboes ato fafatum goa amonai efan taniai nan ireberues ato wengar gagamis reban reban si’yen on nan ass basunai iwanen fatumai iyouten.
Fom nub basun ato Paul a Silas rus on sibabayoi a God aurin sikwakwarer sibifain, sabu ato fafatum goa amonai sireberues simama on osi wat sitatamis.
Ra kaita uruyoi gagamin bag inat, ato fafatum goa an arir ass on engon siyuyunis. Ra kaita metewan engon siruserenen, ato fatum engon sabu imas emon sifeuen.
Fafatum goa kaifarotin on iyenbubur imisir, ato on iyeit fafatum goa metewan on engon siruserenen ato on inos on sabu engon siyayai sinai, on mes on an seri iboseir ato toun itasubun mes.
Baise Paul aumiet bag iyoku iyau, “Om men toum unirabobim mes! Wei engon atonio!”
Fafatum goa kaifarotin on tafa aurin on sabu iyawures ato on iyayai irui Paul a Silas rus nasi sindan irou ann iman sibiror auman.
Namon on osi ibonanawaiis fafatum goa emon sigat ato itetemis iyau, “Bada, yau mamaba anafour ato yawas anboai?”
Osi siyau, “Om Bada Iesu Keriso unitutumai ato unyawas—om awam nanatum mat.”
Namon osi Bada an dura on, on orot aurin a sabu fani ato on an goai simama on auris sikurereb.
On fom wera kaitamomai wat on fafatum goa kaifarotin on iboes ato asi gawud on ibososouis isawar; on awan nanatun mat on engon ra kaita sibapataito.
On Paul a Silas rus iboes mat sinai an goai ato bayu sites siyam. On awan nanatun mat on siyasisir kwakwan, yabin osi ato arimon God situtumai fasinai.
Ra itom ato Rome babadis on tafanam an baifafaro kaifarotis asi babadis on atonio duraiai siyawures sinai, osi siyau, “Osi orot ruam wonikirires singat.”
On mes fafatum goa kaifarotin on Paul iyawur iyau, “Babadis dura siyafar on om a Silas rum on wongat mes. Omi, tufai wonan.”

Baise Paul on tafanam an baifafaro kaifarotis asi babadis auris iyau, “Osi babadis on men auri dura yabin sigaturai, wei mamaba bobo komasin wafour ai ambin, baise osi wasai siborarabi—ato wei on Rome sabu! Namon osi fafatum goa amonai sireberuei. Ato ari on segogoi wei bubuniai nan wangat wanan? Ambin bag! Rome babadis on tous sinnat nin wei sinyateti wangat.”
Tafanam an baifafaro kaifarotis asi babadis on sinai Rome yangan asi babadis on sikasones, ato osi dura sitatam Paul a Silas rus on Rome yangan, osi on siber.
On mes Rome babadis sinai ato auris siyau, omi woinotburei, wei bobo fetag wafour; namon osi sibonanawaiis sigat au koun ato sifefeyanis mafam gagamin sitikirir sitgat mes.
Paul a Silas rus on fafatum goa sikirir ato sinai Lydia an goai nan. Osi nan taitais tutuas baitutumotis sigatures ato duraiai sikufaiwaris ato sikirires sinai.
